name: Purullena (Spain)
description: Vertical tricolour of green, red and green, charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Purullena (a tower, a flower, a fountain and waves).
history: Municipal flag of Purullena; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.

features.role: Purullena arms — tower, flower, fountain and waves
